package settings

import (
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

func TestParseContract(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("preserves_string_values_and_whitespace", func(t *testing.T) {
		raw := []byte(" \n{\"quote\":\"\\\"\",\"slash\":\"\\\\\",\"line\":\"a\\nb\",\"unicode\":\"雪\",\"empty\":\"\"}\t")
		want := map[string]string{
			"quote":   "\"",
			"slash":   "\\",
			"line":    "a\nb",
			"unicode": "雪",
			"empty":   "",
		}

		got, err := Parse(raw)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Parse() error = %v", err)
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
			t.Fatalf("Parse() = %#v, want %#v", got, want)
		}
	})

	t.Run("empty_object_returns_non_nil_map", func(t *testing.T) {
		got, err := Parse([]byte("{}"))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Parse() error = %v", err)
		}
		if got == nil {
			t.Fatal("Parse() returned a nil map")
		}
		if len(got) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("Parse() returned %d entries, want 0", len(got))
		}
	})

	invalid := []struct {
		name string
		raw  string
	}{
		{name: "rejects_duplicate_keys", raw: `{"same":"first","same":"second"}`},
		{name: "rejects_array", raw: `[]`},
		{name: "rejects_null", raw: `null`},
		{name: "rejects_nested_value", raw: `{"key":{"nested":"value"}}`},
		{name: "rejects_number_value", raw: `{"key":1}`},
		{name: "rejects_boolean_value", raw: `{"key":true}`},
		{name: "rejects_null_value", raw: `{"key":null}`},
		{name: "rejects_malformed_input", raw: `{"key":"value"`},
		{name: "rejects_trailing_data", raw: `{"key":"value"} {}`},
	}
	for _, tc := range invalid {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if got, err := Parse([]byte(tc.raw)); err == nil {
				t.Fatalf("Parse(%q) = %#v, nil error; want rejection", tc.raw, got)
			}
		})
	}
}
